messages:
Asha (CS Lead): Drafting a compact customer-facing onboarding runbook (one-pager + internal checklist) focused on caching, batching, streaming, and easy renewal-risk signals. Want a quick review and permission to include in onboarding emails.

Ben (Eng): Looks good. Suggest we provide concrete but conservative defaults customers can copy/paste. Also include a tiny SDK batching example and a token-budget starter.

Asha (CS Lead): Customer one-pager (copyable):
- Pre-go-live 3 actions: 1) Confirm token budget & expected latency target (suggest 5k tokens/day per active user; p95 < 1s). 2) Enable route cache (TTL=75s) using key pattern tenant|route|prompt_prefix to favor repeat interactions. 3) Enable streaming for chat/search flows so partial results improve perceived latency.

Ravi (SRE): Warm pool guidance for pilots: start with 3 warm workers per ~15 active tenants; increase if churn spikes. Use randomized startup delay (0-25s) to avoid synchronized boot storms. Share a small readiness probe customers can apply:
```
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
```

Ben (Eng): Client-side batching recommendation: batch window = 45ms or flush at 7 requests (whichever first). Server-side: cap batches at 64 requests or 240 tokens to balance throughput/latency. Example SDK pseudo:
```js
// conservative example for interactive UIs
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), 45)
if (batch.length >= 7) batcher.flush()
```
Also suggest token-budget starter note: 5k tokens/day per active seat, re-evaluate after 72h telemetry.

Claire (PM): Renewal-risk signals to surface to CS and customers (simple):
- Usage dip: 7d active users down >= 40% -> trigger re-engagement + product walkthrough.
- QoE regression: sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline for 48h -> route to smaller model or enable streaming fallback and notify SRE.
- Reliability: error rate > 1% with at least one open support ticket -> CS bridgecall + remediation plan.
Suggested mitigations: prefill top prompts, cache warmups for high-traffic routes, temporary downgrade for non-critical routes, short-term token credits if SLA impacted.

Asha (CS Lead): For customer-facing copy keep sizing fuzzy (e.g., "start with a few warm workers per dozen tenants") and put exact numbers in internal checklist. ops-bot: create runbook and internal checklist links.

ops-bot: Runbook created: runbooks/cs/onboard-ops-cheatcard-v1 (internal) :page_facing_up:

Asha (CS Lead): Thanks all 44d I'll publish a tidy one-pager for onboarding emails and a detailed internal playbook for CS reps. Will drop the final 1-pager in #cs-docs by EOD.
